status: prospective audit specification; prior original results exposed
metrics: remaining NLL reduction mean and sample SD at steps 1..5
paired_difference: U7C minus U7B, on identical arrays; report per-example discordant correctness counts
aggregation: Report both original suites separately; group means descriptive only. Identical suites are aliases, not independent replicates. No significance tests or population-level success estimates.
decision_rule: For each suite, any exposed seed failing any unchanged gate rejects all-seed rescue on that suite. Both performance gates reported separately. Original failed advancement decisions remain unchanged under every outcome.
stop_rule: Complete all 18 unique evaluations once, then close audit. A verification error stops execution as invalid; repair implementation only, with a recorded amendment before rerun. No outcome-driven sample or threshold changes.
